# The Social Dev

> Software and Web Development Agency creating custom websites, React applications, UI/UX designs, and aesthetic social media content.

## Overview
The Social Dev is a web development and digital agency that bridges high-performance technical engineering with visual storytelling. We build custom, responsive, and high-performance websites and digital solutions tailored for startups, ambitious ventures, and growing brands.

## Core Services
- Website & Web Application Development: Custom landing pages, full-stack React.js applications, Node.js backends, responsive design, and database integration.
- Aesthetic Social Media Content: Visually cohesive social media graphics, creative branding campaigns, and content strategies for digital platforms.
- UI/UX Design & Branding: Conversion-focused interface design, logo creation, color palettes, typography systems, and digital brand guidelines.
